expect_red: the DAG-side card opens from its own rail bar in the short window (the three layout checks that need it open are skipped)

mutations.contract: A rail bar with no hit path fails the hover checks by name; the suite is not aborted.
mutations.note: Renames the bar hit path's class at both its sites (the element and its `base`, which repaints the class), so hoverRailBar finds nothing. Before 2026-10-22 hoverRailBar threw and the suite stopped with ABORTED, which the mutation tier read as a MISS.
mutations.find:
el: fade(VA.svg("line", "rail__barhit",
            { x1: mark.x, y1: y1, x2: mark.x, y2: y2 }), "edge", mark.id),
          base: "rail__barhit",
mutations.replace:
el: fade(VA.svg("line", "rail__barhit_renamed",
            { x1: mark.x, y1: y1, x2: mark.x, y2: y2 }), "edge", mark.id),
          base: "rail__barhit_renamed",
